spans.s:
subst. mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
1 The pomegranate tree, (of mf. the tree, n. the fruit).
2 Small cardamoms.
E.
दल to divide, इमच् affix, the radical vowel made long, and ल changed to ड.

m. (-कः)
A medicinal plant, (Andersonia rohitaka.)
E.
दाडिम as above, पुष्य a flower, and कन् affix of resemblance; bearing flowers like those of the pomegranate.

m. (-यः)
A parrot.
E.
दाडिम the pomegranate, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-णः)
A parrot.
E.
दाडिम a pomegranate, and भक्षण eating.
